resolution.summary: Recommend opt-in read-only beta, not default production promotion of E5. Current18 synthetic trials reached equal quality ceilings while mandatory E5 searches raised observed time/input. Next: selective retrieval only when necessary, harden worker lifecycle/concurrency/cache writers and explicit corpus/source limits, exercise representative larger real project changes against strong Markdown and same-encoder controls with preregistered benefit/cost gates. No production rollout or new implementation authorized by this informational question.
